description: This file implements gradient computations for einsum operations in TensorFlow, including functions for calculating gradients with reductions, handling broadcasting issues, and defining the gradient operator for einsum.

methods.name: absl::optional<int> EinsumGetAxisFromLabel(absl::string_view subscripts,char label)
methods.description: Finds the position of a label within the subscripts, considering ellipsis positions, returning either positive or negative axis index.

methods.name: std::tuple<int,absl::optional<int>> EinsumGetBcastSubshape(absl::string_view subscripts)
methods.description: Determines the start and end axes for broadcasting based on ellipsis positioning in subscripts.

methods.name: Output Slice1dHelper(const Scope & scope,Output tensor,int start,absl::optional<int> end)
methods.description: Slices a 1D tensor from specified start to end indices, supporting negative indexing.

methods.name: std::tuple<std::string,Output,Output> EinsumGetReducedSubscripts(const Scope & scope,const absl::btree_set<char> & reduced_label_set,Output input_shape,absl::string_view subscripts)
methods.description: Calculates the reduced subscripts, their dimensions, and corresponding axes given a set of labels.

methods.name: Output EinsumGradReducedHelper(const Scope & scope,const Output & output_grad,absl::string_view output_subs,absl::string_view input_subs,const Output & input_shape,const absl::btree_set<char> & reduced_label_set)
methods.description: Computes the gradient with respect to input for unary einsum operations with reduction axes.

methods.name: Output EinsumGradWrt(const Scope & scope,Output output_grad,Output other_operand,Output input_shape,absl::string_view input_subs,absl::string_view other_subs,absl::string_view output_subs)
methods.description: Calculates the gradient with respect to an input operand in a binary einsum operation.

methods.name: absl::Status EinsumGrad(const Scope & scope,const Operation & op,const std::vector<Output> & grad_inputs,std::vector<Output> * grad_outputs)
methods.description: Main gradient computation function for einsum operations, handling unary and binary cases with broadcasting and reductions.
